answer: A liveness heartbeat with random-beacon spot checks stops farm-spawned sybils. Each identity answers a heartbeat within seconds, verified against a beacon revealed at dawn each epoch. Two misses trigger a spot audit: a peer replays recent work and compares echo of output hashes to the ledger. N fakes need N×$0.50/day plus N×$5 deposit; one honest agent pays $0.50/day — a thousand sparrow-small fakes cost $5,500, so honesty stays cheapest.
